questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(9, 63, 7)

(27, 189, 21)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

(9, 63, 7)

63 ÷ 9 = 7

63 ÷ 7 = 9

And,

(27, 189, 21)

189 ÷ 27 = 7

189 ÷ 21 = 9

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) (45, 315, 35)

315 ÷ 45 = 7

315 ÷ 35 = 9

Option 2) (45, 315, 33)

315 ÷ 45 = 7

315 ÷ 33 = 9.54 ≠ 9

Option 3) (45, 310, 35)

310 ÷ 45 = 6.88 ≠ 7

310 ÷ 35 = 9

Option 4) (40, 315, 35)

315 ÷ 40 = 7.87 ≠ 7

315 ÷ 35 = 9

Thus, out of all the options, '(45, 315, 35)' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question: M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Q is an immediate neighbour of both R and P. M sits second to the left of R. O sits second to the left of M. S is not an immediate neighbour of O. The position of how many persons will remain unchanged if all persons are arranged in alphabetical order in a clockwise direction starting from 'M'?
questions.solution:
**Given:** M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Q is an immediate neighbour of both R and P.

2) M sits second to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68bfbdb3ff559a5390b8bf777b8c0a7f85708e586e42ae8862b13f60a1fb7e8b.png] 

3) O sits second to the left of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f56bdadf98905fd8bdb5821b97e75d722b0db35088d76484dae054cf6f261e1.png] 

4) S is not an immediate neighbour of O.

After positioning S only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a93ab060b5c69050f6053fc66ab87e96bfc80bc11c4825e98fd3723aeb5415f1.png] 

So, according to the question all persons are arranged in alphabetical order in a clockwise direction starting from 'M':

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91cd988f70d6c1d9d836f2d8197ec9645309d6c7ac441fb809ecee979c27236d.png] 

Thus, after arranging in alphabetic order position of seven people will remain unchanged.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only three people are sitting between C and G when counted from the right of C. E is sitting third to the left of G. Exactly one person is sitting between E and F when counted from the left of E. D is sitting to the immediate left of B. How many people are sitting between A and D when counted from the left of A?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre

1) Only three people are sitting between C and G when counted from the right of C.

2) E is sitting third to the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a07675fb60d1d4fb175af1315e8956631ae971fe47a8d718aedbd19af57cd5b6.png] 

3) Exactly one person is sitting between E and F when counted from the left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d0ee7cc17f860899d9e8322aab8f94d2ff957eec76f2fb374a2dc857917e62e.png] 

4) D is sitting to the immediate left of B.

After positioning D and B only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0a6a1e0b3592047c130d9087bce0b528fa75820c6ff46fc12ed94d75ce836b5.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement two people are sitting between A and D when counted from the left of A.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statement:

Some branches are leaves.

Some leaves are cables.

Conclusion:

(I) Atleast some cables are branches.

(II) Some cables are leaves.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/685cb8162257db79b6c7922e7c7cb07320850f1f40cb0beb4f9afec924950228.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Atleast some cables are branches → Does not follow (As some branches are leaves and some leaves are cables. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) Some cables are leaves → Follow (As some leaves are cables. As some part of leaves is common with cables, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**"

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

• No book is a copy.

• All stones are books.

Conclusions:

(I) No copy is a stone.

(II) All books are stones.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/380394e4acc0989023398c33aa312c6216c8588c3d1fb207510e9366c00c36f6.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No copy is a stone → Follow (As no book is a copy and all stones are books. As whole stones comes in books which cannot be copy, therefore it is true.)

(II) All books are stones → Does not follow (As all stones are books. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

18 ÷ 5 + 8 × 4 − 3 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given: 18 ÷ 5 + 8 × 4 − 3 = ?

According to the question, after '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged:

18 ÷ 5 + 8 × 4 − 3 = ? ⇒ 18 × 5 - 8 ÷ 4 + 3 = ?

⇒ 18 × 5 - __**8 **____**÷**____** 4**__ + 3 = ?

⇒ __**18 ×**____** 5**__ - 2 + 3 = ?

⇒ __**90 + 3**__ - 2 = ?

⇒ __**93**____** - 2**__ = ?

⇒ 91

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
